content.text: 1. SEPARATE PROPELLER SHAFT AND INTERMEDIATE SHAFT

items: (b) Remove the four bolts and nuts.

content.description: Illustration showing propeller shaft and intermediate shaft connection with matchmarks indicated on the flanges

content.text: 2. REMOVE CENTER SUPPORT BEARING FROM INTERMEDIATE SHAFT

items: (a) Using a hammer and chisel, loosen the staked part of the nut.

content.description: Illustration showing the use of hammer and chisel to loosen the staked nut on the intermediate shaft

items: (b) Using SST to hold the flange, remove the nut.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to hold the flange while removing the nut

items: (c) Place alignment marks on the flange or yoke and shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing alignment marks being placed on the flange or yoke and shaft

items: (d) Clamp the flange or yoke in a vise and tap off the shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing the flange or yoke clamped in a vise while tapping off the shaft with a hammer
